about: Stratford is a town in Queens County, Prince Edward Island, across the Hillsborough River from Charlottetown—not Stratford, Ontario. A fast-growing residential suburb of the capital, it mixes waterfront neighbourhoods, farms on the edge of town, and views toward Charlottetown Harbour. About 11,000 people live in Stratford, PE.
